title: Picture clues and describing words
titlePs: انځوریزې نښې او د تشریح کلمې
intro: Pictures can help you work out meaning after you try to read the word. Choose describing words that help a reader see what you mean.
support: لومړی کلمه ولولئ. بیا انځور ته وګورئ چې مانا یې روښانه شي. د تشریح لپاره ځانګړې کلمې وټاکئ.
text:
A red kite tugs at its string.
Mina holds the long string.
The wind is brisk.
model: The string helps you understand what a kite is. Brisk here means lively or fairly strong. A word bank might hold red, long, brisk and tugs.
activity: Make a word bank about a toy. Use two words from your bank in an English description.
adult: Ask the child which picture detail helped and what a new word means in this sentence. Keep word banks for later writing.
adultPs: وپوښتئ چې د انځور کومه برخه مرسته کوي. د نوې کلمې مانا وپوښتئ او د راتلونکې لیکنې لپاره کلمې وساتئ.

rounds.prompt: Mina holds something long. Select it.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.prompt: Select two words that describe the kite or string in the text, in that order.
rounds.hint: The first sentence describes the kite; the second describes its string.

tasks: Read the first sentence. Draw a picture of its main object.
Find the string in a drawing of a kite. Tell how the drawing helps.
Copy two interesting words from the text into a word bank.
Say a word that describes the wind. Use it in a sentence of your own.
Describe the size, shape and colour of a toy in three English phrases.
Draw an object from home and write a caption using a word from your list.
Read your caption to a partner and ask which word helped them imagine the object.
Read: The tiny boat rocks. Draw it and point to the clue that explains boat.
Read: A small boat rocks. A long rope holds it by the bank. List two useful words from this text. Use one to describe a different object.
Explain how a picture might help a reader understand string, after trying to read the word.
